title: Ada and the Smile
author: Bram Marchetti
blurb: Elodie Galloway, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, has spent twenty years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must return what was taken in 1974 before the well refills.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
